reveal.title: Answer and reasoning
reveal.explanation: E03 states that shale erosion undermines support before sandstone breaks away. The recovered packing has an intact seal, lower trace and removed cradle. Only support withdrawal matches all three bench results; it is not an inference from natural erosion alone.
